  PROBLEM: The codex-agent path handles forward-merge fallback PRs but never sets the `auto_merge_summary` variable, unlike the deterministic-skip-merge path which sets it for all branches.
  WHY: The workflow summary step outputs `echo "- **Auto-merge:** ${auto_merge_summary:-N/A}"`. For forward-merge fallback PRs processed by the codex-agent path, the summary will always show "N/A" regardless of whether auto-merge was enabled, failed, or suppressed, which makes the summary inconsistent and less useful.
